# Meta-clustering characterization

I'll run each step of the pipeline for each type of output matrix at the same time, rather than the sequential structure used in 02_snf.qmd.

```{r eval = FALSE}

# Load libraries
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(metasnf)
library(abcdutils)
library(ggplot2)


# Assign paths
proc_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/processed")))
fig_path <- path_maker(here(paste0("data/abcd/results/figures")))


# Importing the output matrices
eom_0_0_train <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_eom_0_0_train.csv"))
eom_fair_0_0_train <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_eom_fair_0_0_train.csv"))
eom_tight_0_0_train <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_eom_tight_0_0_train.csv"))
eom_tight_fair_0_0_train <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_eom_tight_fair_0_0_train.csv"))


# A glimpse at relative discernment for behavioural scores
min(eom_0_0_train$min_p_val) # 1.998e-15, 2nd place
min(eom_0_0_train$mean_p_val) # 0.000898, 1st place

min(eom_fair_0_0_train$min_p_val) # 4.791e-13, 3rd place
min(eom_fair_0_0_train$mean_p_val) # 0.00163, 4th place

min(eom_tight_0_0_train$min_p_val) # 1.443e-15, 1st place
min(eom_tight_0_0_train$mean_p_val) # 0.00162, 2nd place

min(eom_tight_fair_0_0_train$min_p_val) # 9.361e-11, 4th place
min(eom_tight_fair_0_0_train$mean_p_val) # 0.00151, 3rd place


# Identify the lowest p-value solutions for each number of subtypes
top_oms_0_0_train <- top_om_per_cluster(eom_0_0_train)
top_oms_0_0_train |> dplyr::select(c("significance", "row_id"))

top_oms_fair_0_0_train <- top_om_per_cluster(eom_fair_0_0_train)
top_oms_fair_0_0_train |> dplyr::select(c("significance", "row_id"))

top_oms_tight_0_0_train <- top_om_per_cluster(eom_tight_0_0_train)
top_oms_tight_0_0_train |> dplyr::select(c("significance", "row_id"))

top_oms_tight_fair_0_0_train <- top_om_per_cluster(eom_tight_fair_0_0_train)
top_oms_tight_fair_0_0_train |> dplyr::select(c("significance", "row_id"))


# Exporting the files
write_csv(
    top_oms_0_0_train,
    proc_path("top_oms_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE)
)

write_csv(
    top_oms_fair_0_0_train,
    proc_path("top_oms_fair_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE)
)

write_csv(
    top_oms_tight_0_0_train,
    proc_path("top_oms_tight_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE)
)

write_csv(
    top_oms_tight_fair_0_0_train,
    proc_path("top_oms_tight_fair_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE)
)


# Reloading
top_oms_0_0_train <-
    read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_top_oms_0_0_train.csv"))

top_oms_fair_0_0_train <-
    read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_top_oms_fair_0_0_train.csv"))

top_oms_tight_0_0_train <-
    read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_top_oms_tight_0_0_train.csv"))

top_oms_tight_fair_0_0_train <-
    read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_top_oms_tight_fair_0_0_train.csv"))


# Preliminary visualizations of the p-values
om_scatter(
    top_oms_0_0_train,
    title = "All inputs, any number of dropped elements",
    fontsize = 16,
    save = fig_path(
        "top_oms_0_0_train_scatter.pdf",
        date = TRUE
    )
)

om_scatter(
    top_oms_fair_0_0_train,
    title = "No race or income, any number of dropped elements",
    fontsize = 16,
    save = fig_path(
        "top_oms_fair_0_0_train_scatter.pdf",
        date = TRUE
    )
)

om_scatter(
    top_oms_tight_0_0_train,
    title = "All inputs, 1-3 dropped elements",
    fontsize = 16,
    save = fig_path(
        "top_oms_tight_0_0_train_scatter.pdf",
        date = TRUE
    )
)

om_scatter(
    top_oms_tight_fair_0_0_train,
    title = "No race or income, 1-3 dropped elements",
    fontsize = 16,
    save = fig_path(
        "top_oms_tight_fair_0_0_train_scatter.pdf",
        date = TRUE
    )
)

# Calculating inter-solution distances and saving/reloading them
mc_results_0_0_train <- calc_om_aris(eom_0_0_train)

write_csv(data.frame(mc_results_0_0_train),
          proc_path("mc_results_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE))

mc_results_fair_0_0_train <- calc_om_aris(eom_fair_0_0_train)

write_csv(data.frame(mc_results_fair_0_0_train),
          proc_path("mc_results_fair_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE))

mc_results_tight_0_0_train <- calc_om_aris(eom_tight_0_0_train)

write_csv(data.frame(mc_results_tight_0_0_train),
          proc_path("mc_results_tight_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE))

mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train <- calc_om_aris(eom_tight_fair_0_0_train)

write_csv(data.frame(mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train),
          proc_path("mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train.csv", date = TRUE))


mc_results_0_0_train <- as.matrix(
    read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_mc_results_0_0_train.csv"))
)

mc_results_fair_0_0_train <- as.matrix(
    read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_mc_results_fair_0_0_train.csv"))
)

mc_results_tight_0_0_train <- as.matrix(
    read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_mc_results_tight_0_0_train.csv"))
)

mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train <- as.matrix(
    read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train.csv"))
)


# Assigning column and row names
colnames(mc_results_0_0_train) <-
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_0_0_train)))
rownames(mc_results_0_0_train) <-
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_0_0_train)))

colnames(mc_results_fair_0_0_train) <-
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_fair_0_0_train)))
rownames(mc_results_fair_0_0_train) <-
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_fair_0_0_train)))

colnames(mc_results_tight_0_0_train) <-
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_tight_0_0_train)))
rownames(mc_results_tight_0_0_train) <-
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_tight_0_0_train)))

colnames(mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train) <-
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train)))
rownames(mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train) <-
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train)))


# Plotting ARIs between solutions
ari_heatmap(
    mc_results_0_0_train,
    title = "All inputs, any number of dropped elements",
    save = fig_path("mc_results_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE),
    hide_ids = TRUE
)

ari_heatmap(
    mc_results_fair_0_0_train,
    title = "No race or income, any number of dropped elements",
    save = fig_path("mc_results_fair_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE),
    hide_ids = TRUE
)

ari_heatmap(
    mc_results_tight_0_0_train,
    title = "All inputs, 1-3 dropped elements",
    save = fig_path("mc_results_tight_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE),
    hide_ids = TRUE
)

ari_heatmap(
    mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train,
    title = "No race or income, 1-3 dropped elements",
    save = fig_path("mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE),
    hide_ids = TRUE
)

## Trying to plot the input design matrix as a heatmap
mc_order_0_0_train <- get_pheatmap_order(
    mc_results_0_0_train
)

mc_order_fair_0_0_train <- get_pheatmap_order(
    mc_results_fair_0_0_train
)

mc_order_tight_0_0_train <- get_pheatmap_order(
    mc_results_tight_0_0_train
)

mc_order_tight_fair_0_0_train <- get_pheatmap_order(
    mc_results_tight_fair_0_0_train
)


## Design matrix
design_matrix <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_design_matrix.csv"))
design_matrix_fair <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_design_matrix_fair.csv"))
design_matrix_tight <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_design_matrix_tight.csv"))
design_matrix_tight_fair <- read_csv(proc_path("2023_07_26_design_matrix_tight_fair.csv"))

# Original ordering of full design matrix
dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix,
    save = fig_path("dm_original_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE)
)

# Original design matrix reordered by original (full) output matrix
dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix,
    order = mc_order_0_0_train,
    save = fig_path("dm_reordered_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE)
)

# Fair design matrix
dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix_fair,
    save = fig_path("dm_fair_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE)
)

# Fair design matrix reordered by fair output matrix
dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix_fair,
    order = mc_order_fair_0_0_train,
    save = fig_path("dm_reordered_fair_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE)
)

# Tight design matrix
dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix_tight,
    save = fig_path("dm_tight_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE)
)

# Tight design matrix reordered by tight output matrix
dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix_tight,
    order = mc_order_tight_0_0_train,
    save = fig_path("dm_reordered_tight_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE)
)

# Tight and fair design matrix
dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix_tight_fair,
    save = fig_path("dm_tight_fair_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE)
)

# Reordered tight and fair design matrix
dm_heatmap(
    design_matrix_tight_fair,
    order = mc_order_tight_fair_0_0_train,
    save = fig_path("dm_reordered_tight_fair_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE)
)

mc_pvals_0_0_train <- p_val_select(eom_0_0_train)
mc_pvals_fair_0_0_train <- p_val_select(eom_fair_0_0_train)
mc_pvals_tight_0_0_train <- p_val_select(eom_tight_0_0_train)
mc_pvals_tight_fair_0_0_train <- p_val_select(eom_tight_fair_0_0_train)

# All inputs
pvals_pheatmap(
    mc_pvals_0_0_train,
    mc_order_0_0_train,
    save = fig_path("mc_pvals_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE),
    cluster_cols = FALSE
)

# Fair inputs
pvals_pheatmap(
    mc_pvals_fair_0_0_train,
    mc_order_fair_0_0_train,
    save = fig_path("mc_pvals_fair_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE),
    cluster_cols = FALSE
)

# Tight
pvals_pheatmap(
    mc_pvals_tight_0_0_train,
    mc_order_tight_0_0_train,
    save = fig_path("mc_pvals_tight_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE),
    cluster_cols = FALSE
)

# Tight and fair inputs
pvals_pheatmap(
    mc_pvals_tight_fair_0_0_train,
    mc_order_tight_fair_0_0_train,
    save = fig_path("mc_pvals_tight_fair_0_0_train.pdf", date = TRUE),
    cluster_cols = FALSE
)
```
